## Synopsis for "Bloodline"

Set in war torn World War II, Sgt. Fury and a contingent of his "Howling Commandos" are captured by Nazis and their villainous vampire leader [Baron Blood](/wiki/John_Falsworth_(Earth-616) "John Falsworth (Earth-616)")!

## Solicit Synopsis

Revealed: The secrets of CAPTAIN AMERICA's shield! In this first installment of a two-part tale, the answers will be laid bare, as the super soldier must race around the globe in pursuit of something he can't even see!

## Notes

*   This issue contains a letters page, **"American Grafitti"**.  Letters are published from: Harris Mankey, James "Jimmy" Powers, Janettee Langley, Brain Franklin, and Karen Bradley.

*   There is a fourth member of the Howling Commandos shown in the second story: "Bloodline".  However, this editor cannot determine if it is [Dino Manelli (Earth-616)](/wiki/Dino_Manelli_(Earth-616) "Dino Manelli (Earth-616)") or [Isadore Cohen (Earth-616)](/wiki/Isadore_Cohen_(Earth-616) "Isadore Cohen (Earth-616)").
